briefings.title: A Model For Everyone: How Ronak From Trajectory Is Building Products For Continual Learning
briefings.tldr: Ronak Malde, co-founder of Trajectory, explains how his platform democratizes continual learning by combining training, evaluation, and deployment into a single, dead-simple interface, enabling companies to train custom models from production data 6x cheaper than frontier models.

briefings.title: Continual Learning: How AI Agents Get Better With Every Use | Arjun Karanam, Trajectory
briefings.tldr: Arjun Karanam of Trajectory introduces continual learning to close the "experience gap" in AI models, turning discarded interaction tokens into training signals that compound agent performance with every use.
